name: _generic
_readme: Fallback pack: units = folders with a manifest file; no schema/DI/workflow signals; no standard knowledge. Use for smoke tests and as scaffold for new packs (dbcx pack new).

snippets.override_mechanisms: overridden = the standard implementation is replaced (DI override, preference, decorating service that replaces behaviour); extended = subclass/decorator without replacing; shadowed = same class name/namespace overlays vendor code
snippets.schema_sources: entity/schema definition files and migrations of the unit
snippets.read_order: manifest, DI config, schema, routing, templates, data scripts, process definitions, admin config, src, tests (intent only)
snippets.hosting_constraints: state assumptions that break on the target hosting model (file system, cron nodes, SMTP, server config)

snippets.critic2_persona: senior solution architect who has delivered many shops on the source platform and is certified on the target platform
snippets.docs_domains: vendor documentation sites of source and target
snippets.best_practice: extend via DI/plugins, never patch vendor code; business logic in services not controllers/templates; thin API controllers; no session state for UI features on an API-first target
snippets.critic2_focus: D1 deprecation statuses and version facts; D2 real standard counterparts; D3 does the target standard really cover it (package/version); D4 endpoint names and content component support
snippets.expected_hotspots_d3: requirements that today rely on heavily customized code
snippets.expected_blockers_d4: auth model, live pricing/availability, custom content components, session-state features, hosting constraints, data migration of custom entities
snippets.content_model_notes: which content component types the target frontend renders out of the box
